summary: Backend-only review for Aurin P0: Faas1 (Sora2 Grace avatar), Faas2 (Realtime API gating), Operation Open Factory (FREE_ACCESS_UNTIL paywall bypass), Body Room AGOP-C + Ayurveda layer. 10/10 new tests pass after a one-line widening of the valid-tone set to match implementation. 'support' is emitted today; 'gentle_challenge' and 'affirmation' are never emitted; reconcile the system-prompt enum in clarity_ai.py (lines ~491 / 569 / 612) with the AGOP §A spec.

critical_code_review_comments: clarity_realtime.py is clean: 503 gating on REALTIME_MODE off works, no key leak, fallback path documented.

/api/auth/guest persists user + session; Bearer token works against /clarity/access. No PII leakage in guest email pattern.

Schema-prompt drift on tone_tag enum is the only real issue — see action item #1.
test_credentials: guest sessions via POST /api/auth/guest — no human credentials required.

context_for_next_testing_agent: REALTIME_MODE=off and FREE_ACCESS_UNTIL=2026-05-20 are the relevant env vars. Realtime endpoints only return 503 while off — when founder flips to 'on' they will ALSO need OPENAI_API_KEY set or session call returns 503 with a different detail message. The tone_tag enum discrepancy is the only finding worth E1's attention.
rca of the issue: tone_tag='support' surfaced from /api/cabinet/message; clarity_ai.py L491 prompt explicitly instructs Claude to emit tone_tag from {compassion|support|reflection|neutral}; L612 _VALID_TONE whitelist matches. The review request expected AGOP set {neutral, compassion, reflection, gentle_challenge, affirmation}. Pick one source of truth — either update the prompt + validator in clarity_ai.py to the AGOP-A 5-tone set, or update the AGOP spec to keep 'support' and drop 'gentle_challenge'/'affirmation'.
